observations: Photo 0 shows a vehicle gearbox/transmission assembly on a work surface with the bellhousing and internal ring/plate visible.
A blue circular cover/plate is visible on the gearbox housing.
No readable brand/model plate, no clearly readable part number, and no visible pin-count marking in the photo.

claims.evidence: Photo 0 does not show a readable Toyota/Camry identification or a clear 22-pin marking.
Photo 0 has no readable date/production code.
No test/working proof shown (no running/shift test, no fluid condition close-up).
Affordability depends on the exact model/condition, which is not verifiable from Photo 0.

risks.risk: Exact fitment/model mismatch (Camry + 22-pin) cannot be confirmed from the photo; wrong gearbox could be unusable.
risks.proof: Ask for a clear close-up photo of the gearbox identification plate/label (Toyota part number) and any pin-count marking, plus the transmission code stamped on the casing.
risks.if_unproven: Price as a generic used foreign gearbox with unknown pin-count/fitment (worst case: may not match).

risks.risk: Pin-count (22pin) may be incorrect; even if it’s a Toyota gearbox, pin-count differences can prevent proper connection.
risks.proof: Ask for a straight-on photo of the connector/pin area showing the exact number of pins (or a labeled diagram/photo of the connector).
risks.if_unproven: Price as not confirmed pin-count (worst case: treat as incompatible).

risks.risk: Condition/working status not proven (could have internal wear, leaks, or shift issues).
risks.proof: Ask for a short video of the gearbox being tested (gear engagement/shift test) or at minimum photos of fluid level/condition and leak-free exterior.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not working/untested (worst case: needs overhaul).

risks.risk: Manual vs automatic not confirmed; wrong type would be a major mismatch.
risks.proof: Ask for a photo showing the transmission type identifiers (e.g., selector/valve body area for auto, clutch/flywheel interface for manual) or the transmission code.
risks.if_unproven: Price as unknown type (worst case: assume mismatch risk).

proof_requests: Clear close-up of the gearbox identification plate/label with Toyota part number and transmission code (photo).
Clear photo of the connector/pin area showing the exact pin count (22pin confirmation).
Short video showing the gearbox test/shift engagement (or proof it was removed working).
Photos showing whether it is automatic or manual (type confirmation).
response.reason: The photo shows a gearbox assembly, but it does not provide readable identification or pin-count confirmation, and there is no working/test proof. Without those, the correct Camry 22-pin fitment and condition cannot be priced safely.
